build_DDOD_detector: build a DDOD single-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head config modules
run_DDOD_loss: run the DDOD detector loss calculation on a batch of input images and ground truth samples
run_DDOD_predict: run the DDOD detector predict method to get bounding box predictions from input images
run_DDOD_extract_feat: run the DDOD detector extract_feat method to get multi-level features from backbone and neck
review_DDOD_init: review the DDOD detector __init__ to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization
